service_scope: Strict queued protected-green discharge fitted on supported connections only; old movement priors and all 604 nonsignal 0.5 values retained elsewhere. Neither this fit nor its holdout rate check establishes action or traffic performance.
lane_allocation_scope: Aggregate road turn shares fixed, feasible connection allocation approximates within-road lane balancing; current lane readiness is not resolved.
propagation_scope: Route-level effective speed from native SUMO fit; not a per-road free-flow measurement. Rebuild current remaining-travel bins from positions before solving this model.

turn_share_calibration.rule:
Turning shares from observed history trajectories (design input; history only).

Source: SUMO vehroute output of the native fixed-time runs of history days 7001 and 7002 (runs/fixed_seed700x).
For every road u with declared connections, count consecutive road pairs (u, v) over all arrived vehicles of both
days. Share_uv = count_uv / sum_v count_uv when sum_v count_uv >= MIN_COUNT; otherwise the previous declared shares
are kept. Every declared connection target is listed (unobserved targets get share 0). This equals turning-movement
counts at the junctions; no current route, destination or departure is given to any controller.
Writes inputs/network_model.json (turn_priors replaced), design/service_groups.json (declared_turn_share replaced)
and updates inputs/MANIFEST.json. Usage: measure_turns.py
